challenge_title: Too many sources, too much retyping
challenge:
Real estate agencies in Saudi Arabia work with many developers and a constant flow of new projects. Information sits in brochures, messages and spreadsheets, so finding what is available, where it is and who sells it takes time.

Every agency also retypes the same project data, which is slow and leads to mistakes.
built_intro: A web portal where agencies find projects by location and work from one shared set of data.

built.title: An interactive map
built.text: Developer projects on a map of Saudi Arabia, with a live list of what is in view and filters by project status and developer.

built.title: A developer database
built.text: Developers with their projects, so an agent sees who is selling what and where.

built.title: A shared property inventory
built.text: Units for sale with prices, sizes, payment plans and documents on one project card.

built.title: AI-assisted project import
built.text: New projects are read, structured and added to the database automatically, then checked by a person.

built.title: Tools for agents
built.text: Favorites, a personal catalog and messages to the seller, right from the project card.

ai_text: The slow step was entering project data. AI reads incoming project material, extracts the fields that matter and places them in the right records. A person reviews what was added, so the database stays trustworthy.
ai_points: Project material read and structured automatically
Fields placed into the right records
A person reviews before it goes live
